top_signals.title: Trump’s Latin America Allies Deepen Ties With Washington Lenders
top_signals.summary: Latin America’s rightward, market-friendly shift is reshaping its relationship with Donald Trump’s Washington, including new flows of money from the multilateral lenders historically villainized in the region for pushing fiscal austerity.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
